source_title: 11 Times Celebrities Expertly Coordinated Their Halloween Costumes with Their Young Kids - People.com
source_excerpt:
From Brittany and Patrick Mahomes’ elaborate ‘Spider-Man: Into the Spider-Verse’ costumes to Kristen Bell and Dax Shepard’s ‘Anchorman’ theme, see these famous families’ matching Halloween outfits
Witney Carson McAllister/Instagram; Brittany Mahomes/Instagram
When it comes to dressing up for spooky season , it’s a family affair for these famous faces.
For Halloweens past, stars like Kristen Bell and Dax Shepard , and Patrick Mahomes and wife Brittany have gotten their broods together to coordinate the ultimate family costumes with their children. In 2024, the Nobody Wants This actress and Shepard brought the comedic Anchorman characters to life with their two daughters, Lincoln and Delta. In 2025, Mahomes’ family of five took inspiration from the animated hit Spider-Man: Into the Spider-Verse.
Even Alec and Hilaria Baldwin were able to wrangle their seven young children for a coordinated Care Bear costume!
From animated characters to TV and movie legends, see all the creative Halloween costumes worn by celebrities and their kids over the years.
Alec and Hilaria Baldwin with their seven children
The 30 Rock actor and his wife, Hilaria, gathered their massive household of seven children for a cozy, color-coordinated group outfit, with everyone wearing different-colored Care Bear onesies in 2025.
The yoga instructor shared a post on Instagram captioned: “Happy Halloween from the Care-Bear-Wins 🌈🍭❤️🌙✨☀️⛈️🍀🌼🩷🌟.”
The couple, who wed in 2012, share three daughters, Carmen Gabriela, María Lucía Victoria and Ilaria Catalina Irena, as well as four sons, Rafael Thomas, Leonardo Ángel Charles, Romeo Alejandro David and Eduardo “Edu” Pao Lucas.
Bindi Irwin and Chandler Powell with their daughter Grace
Sticking close to their roots, the wildlife conservationists and their daughter, Grace Warrior , took on a fun giraffe-themed safari ensemble in 2024.
The toddler looked adorable in the animal-themed costume that was shared on Instagram .
“Grace the giraffe and her zookeepers here to wish you a happy #Halloween from @australiazoo,” Bindi and Chandler captioned the post.
Neil Patrick Harris and David Burtka with their twins Harper and Gideon
The couple and their twins, daughter Harper Grace and son Gideon Scott , went on a cinematic adventure for Halloween 2025, transforming into characters from Indiana Jones for a custom movie poster titled “Indiana Jones and the Family of Doom.”
“Happy Halloween from the Burtka-Harris Production Company. Copyright 2025, all frights reserved. @dbelicious“ Harris wrote in an Instagram caption .
The poster included a creative tagline for the family, reading, “If Halloween had a name...it must be Burtka-Harris.”
Kristen Bell and Dax Shepard with their daughters Lincoln and Delta
Alongside their daughters, Bell and Shepard committed to channeling the Channel 4 News Team from Anchorman in 2024.
The family was joined by actress Anna Kendrick , who dressed like Christina Applegate ‘s character, Veronica Corningstone. Bell and Shepard’s two daughters, Lincoln and Delta, resembled Brian Fantana ( Paul Rudd ) and Brick Tamland ( Steve Carell ).
“Ladies and Gentlemen the Channel 4 news Team! 🎃👻💀,” Bell captioned her Instagram post . “And thank you to everybody’s favorite neighborhood gear head for the most epic hayride!!!”
Patrick and Brittany Mahomes with their kids Sterling, Golden and Bronze
The Super Bowl quarterback and his family brought the multiverse to life by matching in elaborate Spider-Man: Into the Spider-Verse costumes in 2025. Patrick hinted at the inspiration behind their costumes in the comment section of Brittany’s Instagram post by sharing an animated GIF of the animated series, which follows the adventures of grade-school incarnations of Peter Parker, Gwen Stacy and Miles Morales .
The couple shared some sweet photos of their daughters, Sterling Skye and Golden , dressed as Spider-Gwen. Meanwhile, son Patrick “Bronze” Lavon III dressed as Spider-Man.
Patrick donned a Miles Morales costume, while Brittany went as the Spider-Man and his Amazing Friends version of Aunt May.
Allison Holker and her kids Weslie, Maddox and Zaia
In 2025, Allison Holker and her three children brought the beloved Toy Story toys to life .
The dancer revealed her Little Bo Peep costume on Instagram , posing with her blue cane and an arm around her now-fiancé, Adam Edmunds , who dressed as Woody.
The So You Think You Can Dance alum’s son Maddox dressed as Buzz Lightyear, while her daughter Zaia went as Jessie. Older daughter Weslie dressed as Barbie, wearing a blue jumpsuit, pink belt and pink legwarmers.
“Happy Halloween 2025 👻🎃🍁 Toy Story,” Holker captioned the post.
Witney Carson and Carson McAllister with their sons Leo and Jet
Witney Carson and her husband, Carson McAllister , sprinkled some pixie dust for Halloween 2025, coordinating an enchanting group look as Peter Pan, Tinker Bell and the Lost Boys.
“Really wish we could go to Neverland so these boys would stop growing up 😭✨🏴‍☠️🪝such a fun night with @disneyplus! I looove this time of year,” the Dancing with the Stars pro wrote on Instagram alongside a photo with her sons Leo and Jet .
Sticking to epic fantasy, Keke and her son Leodis “Leo” Andrellton coordinated an impressive mother-son tribute to Game of Thrones in 2024.
The Emmy award winner posed on the Iron Throne while dressed as Queen Cersei Lannister. Her young son sat on her lap as Cersei’s son, King Joffrey I Baratheon, from the hit series.
“I, Cersei Lannister, introduce YOU to the heir of the throne!” the proud mom wrote on Instagram . “And he will absolutely OFF w/ your head. 🤣♥️.”
Tamera Mowry and Adam Housley with kids Aden and Ariah
The Sister, Sister star got her entire household to embrace the spooky spirit by dressing up as the Addams Family in 2024.
The actress shares son Aden and daughter Ariah with her husband, Adam Housley , whom she married in 2011.
“Had to go with the classic #theaddamsfamily 🕸️. One of our fav cartoons to watch when we were kids. How’s we do?! 🎃,” the mom of two wrote on Instagram .
Deena Cortese and Christopher Buckner with sons CJ and Cameron
The Jersey Shore star turned Halloween into a family gaming session, with her husband and kids transforming into Princess Peach, Mario, Luigi and Wario in 2024.
“Annual Buckner Halloween Party 🎃👻,” she captioned a family photo of the crew all dressed up.
Cortese shares two sons with husband Chris Buckner , CJ and Cameron.
Uzo Aduba and Robert Seeting with their daughter Adaiba
The Orange Is the New Black star and her family coordinated a sweet trip to the Hundred Acre Wood in 2024, dressing up as characters from Winnie the Pooh.
The whole gang was together on Halloween, with Uzo Aduba rocking an Eeyore onesie and her husband, Robert Sweeting , dressed as Pooh. Their daughter Adaiba donned a cute Piglet costume, while their dog wore a Tigger outfit.
“Definitely a TREAT! Happy Halloween from all of us in The Hundred Acre Woods:). 🩷💙💛,” Aduba captioned the snap .
